name: EPIC 248780131

text.card: A red giant 7,203 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.75 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,806 K at its surface.
